Treat missing announcement timing as its own group. Select timings whose mean institutional ownership exceeds the unweighted mean of all timing-group means; return the mean of the selected timing means and their mean excess over that group-wide mean

Allow missing timing as a candidate group, but calculate the comparison average from records with a known timing and nonmissing ownership; return the mean of the selected timing means and their mean excess over that comparison average

Allow missing timing as a candidate group, but calculate the comparison average as the unweighted mean of known-timing group means; return the mean of the selected timing means and their mean excess over that comparison average

Use the record-wide mean for records with a known timing as the comparison average, then report the selected timings’ mean excess as a percentage of that average

queries:
WITH timing_means AS (
  SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS mean_ownership
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY eventannotm
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS mean_ownership
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
)
SELECT
  AVG(t.mean_ownership) AS mean_selected_ownership,
  AVG(t.mean_ownership - o.mean_ownership) AS mean_excess
FROM timing_means AS t
CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS o
WHERE t.mean_ownership > o.mean_ownership

WITH timing_means AS (
  SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS mean_ownership
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY eventannotm
),
group_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(mean_ownership) AS mean_ownership
  FROM timing_means
)
SELECT
  AVG(t.mean_ownership) AS mean_selected_ownership,
  AVG(t.mean_ownership - g.mean_ownership) AS mean_excess
FROM timing_means AS t
CROSS JOIN group_mean AS g
WHERE t.mean_ownership > g.mean_ownership

WITH comparison AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS comparison_average
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE eventannotm IS NOT NULL
    AND instownpct IS NOT NULL
),
timing_means AS (
  SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS timing_mean
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY eventannotm
)
SELECT
  AVG(timing_mean) AS mean_selected_timing_means,
  AVG(timing_mean - comparison_average) AS mean_excess
FROM timing_means
CROSS JOIN comparison
WHERE timing_mean > comparison_average

WITH timing_ownership AS (
    SELECT
        eventannotm,
        SUM(instownpct) AS ownership_sum,
        COUNT(instownpct) AS ownership_count
    FROM sentimentandfundamentals
    WHERE eventannotm IS NOT NULL
      AND instownpct IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY eventannotm
),
comparisons AS (
    SELECT
        ownership_sum * 1.0 / ownership_count AS timing_mean,
        (SUM(ownership_sum) OVER () - ownership_sum) * 1.0
            / NULLIF(SUM(ownership_count) OVER () - ownership_count, 0) AS other_mean
    FROM timing_ownership
)
SELECT
    AVG(timing_mean),
    AVG(timing_mean - other_mean)
FROM comparisons
WHERE timing_mean > other_mean

WITH overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS mean_ownership
    FROM sentimentandfundamentals
),
timing_means AS (
    SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS mean_ownership
    FROM sentimentandfundamentals
    WHERE eventannotm IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY eventannotm
)
SELECT AVG((timing_means.mean_ownership - overall.mean_ownership) * 100.0
           / NULLIF(overall.mean_ownership, 0)) AS average_excess_pct
FROM timing_means
CROSS JOIN overall
WHERE timing_means.mean_ownership > overall.mean_ownership
